acceptedScope: protected-data leakage gates, current-fence evidence, sanitized-state limitation, and external authority exclusions
findings: The exact review subject and limitations hashes match; all twelve subject bindings and four public-document digests resolve without drift.

Strict field sets, duplicate and non-finite JSON rejection, bounded subprocesses, safe diagnostics, and 49 recorded semantic mutation cases preserve the fail-closed surface across protected content, bindings, counts, authority, lifecycle, and malformed inputs.

Committed evidence contains no protected sentinels, sensitive authentication material, or private paths; bounded diagnostic streams report zero post-redaction matches, and PostgreSQL evidence remains structural only.

PyYAML is exactly pinned to 6.0.3 with installed-distribution provenance checks and isolated workflow bootstrap; YAML parsing rejects aliases, anchors, explicit tags, merge keys, duplicate keys, multi-document streams, oversized input, and unsupported shapes.

HEAD descends from the landed source; all 24 non-evolved capability paths are byte-equivalent to landed Git blobs, normally indexed, free of staged or semantic worktree changes, and protected from replacement-ref substitution.

All five capture-to-landed overrides match their landed blobs, including DaprTestContainerFixture.cs 0da109af79cb0ded1c9e7377c4140a561ef682f1cf23b7c0fbb6284b7401c216 to 28a89849a864014f4e18ab0bd791c4e905cc662799c8a58fce7e9627762dde9a; all nine external-authority fields remain false.
